scope: Sanitized Home Assistant serial-console evidence for the nRF5340 integration.

captures.notes: nRF5340 DK, one NFC tap and one UWB ranging session. Protocol frame dumps, key material, session identifiers, and Matter transport lines were removed; the retained lines are verbatim.

required_hardware_cases.purpose: Record VCOM1 USB metadata without storing its raw serial number.
Capture a normal boot with ANSI colour disabled.
Capture a PRETTY console boot with ANSI colour enabled.
Capture the aliro status response in healthy and degraded states.
Capture aliro frames on, query, and off responses.
Capture aliro range with no reading, trusted reading, untrusted reading, and NLOS.
Capture one granted and one denied access result with credential text redacted.
Capture split, invalid UTF-8, oversized, and malformed console input through the host harness.
Capture unplug, board reset, rediscovery, and reopen without changing logical device identity.
Record direct-serial results for Home Assistant OS, Container, and Core.
